comment: Zone/region capacity failover for ephemeral Dataproc CLUSTER creation (GPU capacity is zonal and stocks out transiently). The submitter tries the deployment region's auto-zone first (unchanged behavior), then that region's other zones on the deployment subnet, then any OTHER region below that has a 'subnetwork_uri' set. Same-region zone failover needs no edits. Cross-region failover is opt-in: fill in 'subnetwork_uri' with a subnet (relative form projects/PROJECT/regions/REGION/subnetworks/NAME) that has Cloud NAT + Private Google Access in that region; a null entry is listed-but-skipped. Point at a custom file with SF_COMPUTE_FALLBACK. This list is a runtime detail only and never affects run_id.
